# Part 19 · Filter On. Answers Gone.

**Engineering** · Published 10 Oct 2026

> How do you build an AI search agent that respects user roles and still finds the right document?

You added a role filter to your company's AI search agent so interns can't see salaries. An intern asks whether she can carry over unused leave, the five closest documents are all manager policies, the filter removes them, and the agent says "no policy found".

![Whiteboard for Part 19](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Put the role filter inside the first query, before any top-k. For the intern, WHERE runs before LIMIT.
2. Fetch wide with the cheap search, then sort again before the cut. For the intern, 50 in, 5 out.
3. Log the cited document's rank before reranking. If it keeps arriving near 50, widen the first stage.
